options.name: Add Menu Buttons for Mod Info
options.description: Add Menu Buttons to display Cube Recipes, Crafting Recipes and Runewords in the pause menu.

groups.name: Unique Items
groups.description: Configure Exalted Uniques and Chronicle behavior.

options.name: Exalted Uniques
options.description: Unique item drops have a chance (5%) to be 'exalted' with pre defined better and additional stats.

options.name: Exalted Uniques only in Terror Zones
options.description: Exalted Uniques items can only drop in Terror Zones. These items can drop in all difficulties.

options.name: Exalted drop chance
options.description: Changes the chance of an item dropping exalted. 5% is default and highly recommended.

groups.name: Set Items
groups.description: Configure Mythic Sets and Chronicle behavior.

options.name: Mythic Sets
options.description: Set item drops have a chance (5%) to be 'mythic' with additional stats. Elite sets and some exceptional set pieces get 1 additional stat, all other get 2. Stats are picked from 8 common, 8 uncommon, 8 rare and 8 ultra rare stats. Ratio 600/300/99/1. Set bonuses of Mythic Sets are also improved.

options.name: Mythic Sets only in Terror Zones
options.description: Mythic Set items can only drop in Terror Zones. These items can drop in all difficulties.

options.name: Mythic drop chance
options.description: Changes the chance of an item dropping mythic. 5% is default and highly recommended.

options.name: Ultra rare Mythic stats
options.description: The rarest tier a Mythic stat can roll, at 1 in 1000: +1 to Teleport, Frozen Armor, Amplify Damage or Lower Resist as an oskill, or a level 5 Might, Blessed Aim, Holy Freeze or Conviction aura. Every Mythic stat draws from it - on Mythic Sets, on Mythic crafts and on cube upgraded rares and magics. Turn it off to cap Mythic stats at the rare tier.

options.name: Warlord's Glory set can drop
options.description: Enables Warlord's Glory set to drop. This set is normally only available through the chinese promo version of D2R.

options.name: Mythic Crafting
options.description: Crafted items have a chance (5%) to get an additional mythic stat depending on the item type. Same mechanic as for mythic set items.

options.name: Craft Mythic property chance
options.description: Changes the chance of crafting an item with an additional mythic property.

options.name: Remove item restriction
options.description: Crafting recipes accept all items of their category (weapons, gloves, boots, etc.)

options.name: Recipes for Topaz and Diamond
options.description: Add new crafting recipes for Topaz and Diamond

options.name: Crafts can roll ethereal
options.description: Allows crafting results to randomly be ethereal. 5% Chance - same as any item drop

options.name: Cube Socket Quest
options.description: Cube all 4 essences with an item to apply the same effect as lazurks quest reward.

options.name: Add mythic stat to rare items
options.description: Add cube recipes to add a mythic property to a rare item for Standard of Heroes plus a Rune (up to Ist) depending on the item.

options.name: Add mythic stat to magic items
options.description: Add cube recipes to add a mythic property to a magic item for Standard of Heroes plus a Rune (up to Fal) depending on the item.

options.name: Craft Standard of Heroes
options.description: Add cube recipes for crafting Standard of Heroes. Cube any Act Statue together with all 5 Worldstone Shards. Standard of Heroes is used in mythic recipes.

options.name: Simplified Rune upgrades
options.description: Low runes don't need gems anymore for an upgrade. '3x Thul -> Amn' and upwards can be cubed directly

options.name: Additional Runewords by this mod
options.description: Adds new Runewords by this mod.

options.name: Reworked vanilla Runewords
options.description: Rebalances the stats of many vanilla Runewords (values tuned by this mod). Turning this off keeps all vanilla Runewords unchanged.

options.name: Vanilla Uniques
options.description: Turning this off removes all vanilla (non-exalted) Uniques from the chronicle.

options.name: Uniques added by this mod
options.description: Attention!!! Currently a bug can crash the game when a modded unique gets saved to the chronicle. Turn this off until Blizzard fixes it! Turning this off removes every Unique this mod adds from the chronicle - the exalted ones and the mod's own new Uniques alike, since the chronicle identifies an item by its place in the table. If shift RotW uniques is enabled, those uniques are excluded as well (bug related).

options.name: Vanilla Sets
options.description: Turning this off removes all vanilla (non-mythic) Set items from the chronicle.

options.name: Mythic Sets
options.description: Turning this off removes all mythic Set items from the chronicle.

groups.name: Sunder Charms
groups.description: Configure the Sunder Charm drop ratio.

options.name: Sunder Charms equal drop rate
options.description: Each Sunder Charm has the same drop chance. Usually/vanilla some sunders drop more often with the following weight: Cold 30, Fire 30, Light 20, Poison 12, Physical 6, Magic 3

options.name: Duriel drops like the other act bosses
options.description: Stops the town portal scroll spam and cuts his gold and junk down to what Andariel and Mephisto drop, so what falls is mostly equipment. Applies in every difficulty and in terror zones.

options.name: Wolf/Bear teleport
options.description: Allows you to use Teleport skill while transformed.

options.name: Perfect Gem drops
options.description: Perfect gems can drop from monster in Hell. Other gems drop less often. The overall gem values are still the same. (You will not have more Perfect Gems, than before, if you cube all gems you find)

options.name: Reworked magic Affixes
options.description: Rebalances the value ranges of many magic prefixes and suffixes (magic/rare item rolls). Turning this off keeps all vanilla affix values.

options.name: Moves RotW uniques to the end - read info
options.description: Only relevant for save files with exalted items found before this mod got updated to RotW. Without this option, existing exalted items can have wrong names und sometimes wrong level requirements. New found items will not be affected. Also disables chronicle entries for RotW added uniques if exalted uniques chronicle is disabled (important for chronicle crash bug).

options.name: Allow multi normal Unique drops
options.description: Normal uniques can drop more than once per game. This is to not break exalted chance. Without this option a second unique item drop in the same game would be guaranteed to be exalted.
